changes.evidence: In X-Men: The Last Stand, Callisto already leads her own band of outcast mutants (filed as The Omegas) when she meets Magneto at the underground mutant gathering; she and her gang then ally with Magneto and join his Brotherhood. She is never in the Brotherhood before her gang, so the opening Brotherhood stage is wrong and her past group goes first (name 'The Omegas' kept as the dataset's existing name; its wording is a separate open owner call).
